Message:
Ever since that day,
I feel like I’ve been
able to grow up,
just a little bit.

When I’m sad,
I let myself cry it out...
then smile!
I’m not holding back
how I feel anymore.

Sometimes, when I think
about Mommy and Daddy,
I still get a bit lonely...
Because I found a new family...

Gracie and Anne are always
there to cheer me up,
so I can smile for real again!

“Hehe! Well,
would you look at that.
It’s not all burnt this time.”

Whenever Gracie has
a smile on her face,
I feel like smiling too.

I get all warm and fuzzy
with happiness...and it only
makes me wanna see her
smile even more!

This nice, warm fuzziness...
Mommy and Daddy must
have felt it too, huh?

One smile leading to another,
until everyone feels happy...
